stem: Which sentence from the selection shows that Joshua John Ward was successful in choosing the design he used to create hammocks?

options.label: A
options.text: Hammocks were soon exposed to the rest of the world. (paragraph 6)

options.label: B
options.text: He was interested in creating cool beds for his riverboat. (paragraph 6)

options.label: C
options.text: He created hammocks out of cotton rope. (paragraph 6)

options.label: D
options.text: His company still makes hammocks using the same materials. (paragraph 6)
